title: IBRANCE (palbociclib): Dose and Continuation Triage
instruction: For each finding, decide whether the FDA label or pivotal trial evidence calls for modifying or interrupting the IBRANCE dose, or for continuing the current dose unchanged.

items.prompt: Grade 3 neutropenia recurring on Day 1 of a new 28-day treatment cycle
items.rationale: Label dose-modification guidance specifies that Grade 3 (or recurrent Grade 3) neutropenia on Day 1 of a cycle requires withholding IBRANCE until recovery to Grade ≤2, then resuming at the next lower dose.

items.prompt: Grade 1 or 2 neutropenia sustained through the first six treatment cycles
items.rationale: For patients with no more than Grade 1 or 2 neutropenia in the first 6 cycles, the label shifts CBC monitoring to every 3 months and states no dose adjustment is required.

items.prompt: Child-Pugh class B (moderate) hepatic impairment identified before starting therapy
items.rationale: The label states no dose adjustment is required for mild or moderate hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh classes A and B); the 75 mg reduced starting dose applies only to severe (Child-Pugh C) impairment.

citations.title: Label: IBRANCE- palbociclib tablet, film coated - DailyMed

items.prompt: Child-Pugh class C (severe) hepatic impairment identified before starting therapy
items.rationale: For severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh class C), the label recommends starting IBRANCE at a reduced dose of 75 mg once daily on the same 21-days-on/7-days-off schedule.

items.prompt: New cough with no hypoxia, suspected to reflect pneumonitis
items.rationale: The label directs that any new or worsening respiratory symptom suspected to be pneumonitis—regardless of severity—requires immediate interruption of IBRANCE and evaluation of the patient.

items.prompt: No objective tumor response seen on the first on-treatment restaging scan
items.rationale: An exploratory PALOMA-2 analysis found PFS was significantly prolonged with palbociclib plus letrozole versus placebo regardless of whether patients achieved an objective response, so absence of response alone does not indicate a dosing change.

citations.title: Progression-free Survival Outcome Is Independent of Objective Response... Analysis From PALOMA-2 - ScienceDirect

items.prompt: Need for a strong CYP3A inhibitor that cannot be switched to an alternative agent
items.rationale: The label states that if coadministration of IBRANCE with a strong CYP3A inhibitor cannot be avoided, the IBRANCE dose should be reduced because such inhibitors substantially increase palbociclib exposure.

items.prompt: Grade 4 neutropenia detected on a routine cycle-start complete blood count
items.rationale: The label recommends dose interruption, dose reduction, or delay in starting a treatment cycle for patients who develop Grade 3 or 4 neutropenia.
